camel_example: aliyun sas CreateSasTrial --region cn-hangzhou --FromEcs true --TryType 1 --TryVersion 7 --RequestForm '{"TryReason":"for_poc"}' --Lang zh --ClientToken 'example-string'
description_en: Starts a trial of Security Center
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-sas-trial --try-version 7 --from-ecs true --try-type 1 --request-form TryReason=for_poc --lang zh --client-token example-string --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSasTrial

parameters.help_en:
The trial version. Valid values:
3: Enterprise Edition.
7: Ultimate Edition.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623574.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
试用版本。取值：
3：企业版
7：旗舰版

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623574.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: try_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the request is from the ECS console. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否来自ECS控制台，取值：
true：是
false：否
parameters.name: from_ecs

parameters.help_en:
The trial type. Valid values:
0: trial not allowed.
1: first trial.
2: second trial.


Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623574.html operation to obtain this parameter. A trial can be started only when the value is not 0
parameters.help_zh:
试用类型，取值：
0：禁止试用
1：首次试用
2：二次试用


调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623574.html接口获取此参数，不为0时才可开启试用
parameters.name: try_type

fields.help_en: The reason for applying for a trial
fields.name: try_reason

parameters.help_en: The reason for applying for a trial. This parameter is required for a second trial
parameters.help_zh: 申请试用理由，二次试用必须填写理由
parameters.name: request_form

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
